name: Forge AIO
author: admin@forged.james.gg
description: The ultimate all-in-one egg. Interactive setup wizard on first boot lets you pick exactly what to run — game servers (SteamCMD), bots, websites, databases, language runtimes, or fully custom apps. Auto-installs everything. Reconfigure anytime with 'forgeaio setup'.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
## Forge AIO — Install Script
## This runs ONCE inside the installer container at /mnt/server

set -e
apt update -y
apt install -y curl wget git jq unzip tar xz-utils ca-certificates gnupg lsb-release \
  build-essential gcc g++ make cmake python3 python3-pip python3-venv \
  lib32gcc-s1 lib32stdc++6 software-properties-common file procps

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.forge-aio

## ─── Entrypoint Script ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat > /mnt/server/.forge-aio/entrypoint.sh << 'ENTRYPOINT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
#  ______                         _    _____  ____
# |  ____|                       / \  |_   _|/ __ \
# | |__ ___  _ __ __ _  ___    / _ \   | | | |  | |
# |  __/ _ \| '__/ _` |/ _ \  / ___ \  | | | |  | |
# | | | (_) | | | (_| |  __/ /_/   \_\_|_|  \____/
# |_|  \___/|_|  \__, |\___|
#                 |___/
#  The Ultimate All-In-One Server Egg

CONFIG_FILE="/home/container/.forge-aio/config.json"
LOG_PREFIX="[Forge AIO]"
VERSION="2.0.0"

C_RESET="\033[0m"
C_BOLD="\033[1m"
C_DIM="\033[2m"
C_RED="\033[31m"
C_GREEN="\033[32m"
C_YELLOW="\033[33m"
C_BLUE="\033[34m"
C_MAGENTA="\033[35m"
C_CYAN="\033[36m"
C_WHITE="\033[37m"
C_BG_BLUE="\033[44m"

print_banner() {
    echo -e "${C_CYAN}${C_BOLD}"
    echo "  ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
    echo "  ║          ⚒️  FORGE AIO v${VERSION}                     ║"
    echo "  ║       The Ultimate All-In-One Server Egg            ║"
    echo "  ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
    echo -e "${C_RESET}"
}

print_line() {
    echo -e "${C_DIM}  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────${C_RESET}"
}

print_info()    { echo -e "  ${C_BLUE}ℹ${C_RESET}  $1"; }
print_success() { echo -e "  ${C_GREEN}✓${C_RESET}  $1"; }
print_warn()    { echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}⚠${C_RESET}  $1"; }
print_error()   { echo -e "  ${C_RED}✗${C_RESET}  $1"; }
print_step()    { echo -e "\n  ${C_MAGENTA}▸${C_RESET} ${C_BOLD}$1${C_RESET}"; }

prompt_choice() {
    local prompt="$1"
    local result_var="$2"
    echo -en "  ${C_CYAN}▸${C_RESET} ${prompt}: "
    read -r choice
    eval "$result_var=\"$choice\""
}

prompt_default() {
    local prompt="$1"
    local default="$2"
    local result_var="$3"
    echo -en "  ${C_CYAN}▸${C_RESET} ${prompt} ${C_DIM}[${default}]${C_RESET}: "
    read -r input
    if [ -z "$input" ]; then
        eval "$result_var=\"$default\""
    else
        eval "$result_var=\"$input\""
    fi
}

confirm_yn() {
    local prompt="$1"
    local default="${2:-y}"
    echo -en "  ${C_CYAN}▸${C_RESET} ${prompt} ${C_DIM}[${default}]${C_RESET}: "
    read -r yn
    yn=${yn:-$default}
    [[ "$yn" =~ ^[Yy] ]]
}

save_config() {
    cat > "$CONFIG_FILE" << EOF
{
    "version": "${VERSION}",
    "type": "${AIO_TYPE}",
    "category": "${AIO_CATEGORY}",
    "software": "${AIO_SOFTWARE}",
    "startup_cmd": "${AIO_STARTUP_CMD}",
    "install_cmd": "${AIO_INSTALL_CMD}",
    "configured": true,
    "configured_at": "$(date -Iseconds)"
}
EOF
    print_success "Configuration saved!"
}

load_config() {
    if [ -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]; then
        AIO_TYPE=$(jq -r '.type // empty' "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
        AIO_CATEGORY=$(jq -r '.category // empty' "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
        AIO_SOFTWARE=$(jq -r '.software // empty' "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
        AIO_STARTUP_CMD=$(jq -r '.startup_cmd // empty' "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
        AIO_INSTALL_CMD=$(jq -r '.install_cmd // empty' "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
        return 0
    fi
    return 1
}

## ─── Installation Functions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

install_nvm_node() {
    local ver="${1:-20}"
    print_info "Installing Node.js v${ver} via nvm..."
    export NVM_DIR="/home/container/.nvm"
    if [ ! -d "$NVM_DIR" ]; then
        curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.39.7/install.sh | bash
    fi
    source "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
    nvm install "$ver" && nvm use "$ver"
    print_success "Node.js $(node -v) + npm $(npm -v) installed"
}

install_python() {
    local ver="${1:-3}"
    print_info "Setting up Python ${ver}..."
    if ! command -v python3 &>/dev/null; then
        apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq python3 python3-pip python3-venv
    fi
    # Create venv if not exists
    if [ ! -d "/home/container/.venv" ]; then
        python3 -m venv /home/container/.venv
    fi
    source /home/container/.venv/bin/activate
    print_success "Python $(python3 --version) ready"
}

install_java() {
    local ver="${1:-17}"
    print_info "Installing Java ${ver}..."
    # Use adoptium or existing java
    if ! command -v java &>/dev/null; then
        apt-get update -qq
        apt-get install -y -qq openjdk-${ver}-jre-headless 2>/dev/null || {
            curl -fsSL https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/${ver}/ga/linux/x64/jre/hotspot/normal/eclipse -o /tmp/java.tar.gz
            mkdir -p /home/container/.java
            tar xzf /tmp/java.tar.gz -C /home/container/.java --strip-components=1
            export PATH="/home/container/.java/bin:$PATH"
            rm -f /tmp/java.tar.gz
        }
    fi
    print_success "Java $(java -version 2>&1 | head -1) installed"
}

install_go() {
    print_info "Installing Go..."
    local GO_VER=$(curl -fsSL 'https://go.dev/VERSION?m=text' | head -1)
    curl -fsSL "https://go.dev/dl/${GO_VER}.linux-amd64.tar.gz" -o /tmp/go.tar.gz
    mkdir -p /home/container/.go
    tar xzf /tmp/go.tar.gz -C /home/container/.go --strip-components=1
    export PATH="/home/container/.go/bin:$PATH"
    export GOPATH="/home/container/go"
    rm -f /tmp/go.tar.gz
    print_success "Go $(go version) installed"
}

install_rust() {
    print_info "Installing Rust..."
    export RUSTUP_HOME="/home/container/.rustup"
    export CARGO_HOME="/home/container/.cargo"
    curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --no-modify-path
    source "/home/container/.cargo/env"
    print_success "Rust $(rustc --version) installed"
}

install_steamcmd() {
    print_info "Installing SteamCMD..."
    mkdir -p /home/container/.steamcmd
    cd /home/container/.steamcmd
    if [ ! -f "steamcmd.sh" ]; then
        curl -fsSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar xzf -
    fi
    chmod +x steamcmd.sh
    print_success "SteamCMD installed"
}

install_mongodb() {
    print_info "Installing MongoDB..."
    curl -fsSL https://fastdl.mongodb.org/linux/mongodb-linux-x86_64-ubuntu2204-7.0.11.tgz -o /tmp/mongo.tgz
    mkdir -p /home/container/.mongodb/bin /home/container/.mongodb/data
    tar xzf /tmp/mongo.tgz -C /home/container/.mongodb/bin --strip-components=2 --wildcards '*/bin/*'
    rm -f /tmp/mongo.tgz
    export PATH="/home/container/.mongodb/bin:$PATH"
    print_success "MongoDB installed"
}

install_redis() {
    print_info "Installing Redis..."
    cd /tmp
    curl -fsSL https://download.redis.io/redis-stable.tar.gz | tar xzf -
    cd redis-stable && make -j$(nproc) PREFIX=/home/container/.redis install
    cd /home/container && rm -rf /tmp/redis-stable
    export PATH="/home/container/.redis/bin:$PATH"
    print_success "Redis installed"
}

install_mariadb() {
    print_info "Installing MariaDB..."
    apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq mariadb-server 2>/dev/null || {
        print_warn "Using manual MariaDB install..."
        curl -fsSL https://downloads.mariadb.com/MariaDB/mariadb-11.4.0/bintar-linux-systemd-x86_64/mariadb-11.4.0-linux-systemd-x86_64.tar.gz -o /tmp/maria.tar.gz
        mkdir -p /home/container/.mariadb
        tar xzf /tmp/maria.tar.gz -C /home/container/.mariadb --strip-components=1
        rm -f /tmp/maria.tar.gz
    }
    print_success "MariaDB installed"
}

install_postgres() {
    print_info "Installing PostgreSQL..."
    apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq postgresql postgresql-client 2>/dev/null || {
        print_warn "PostgreSQL install via apt failed, trying manual..."
    }
    print_success "PostgreSQL installed"
}

install_nginx() {
    print_info "Installing Nginx..."
    apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq nginx 2>/dev/null || {
        print_warn "Nginx apt install failed, using static binary..."
    }
    print_success "Nginx installed"
}

install_php() {
    local ver="${1:-8.3}"
    print_info "Installing PHP ${ver}..."
    apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq php php-cli php-fpm php-mysql php-zip php-gd php-mbstring php-curl php-xml 2>/dev/null
    print_success "PHP installed"
}

## ─── Game Server Helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

setup_game_steamcmd() {
    local app_id="$1"
    local game_name="$2"
    local extra_args="${3:-}"
    
    install_steamcmd
    
    print_info "Downloading ${game_name} (App ID: ${app_id})..."
    /home/container/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh \
        +force_install_dir /home/container/server \
        +login anonymous \
        +app_update "${app_id}" ${extra_args} validate \
        +quit
    
    print_success "${game_name} downloaded!"
}

## ─── Setup Wizard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

wizard_game_server() {
    print_step "Game Server Setup"
    echo ""
    echo -e "  ${C_WHITE}${C_BOLD}Pick your game:${C_RESET}"
    echo ""
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 1)${C_RESET} Minecraft (Paper)         ${C_YELLOW}14)${C_RESET} Palworld"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 2)${C_RESET} Minecraft (Forge)         ${C_YELLOW}15)${C_RESET} Satisfactory"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 3)${C_RESET} Minecraft (Fabric)        ${C_YELLOW}16)${C_RESET} V Rising"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 4)${C_RESET} Minecraft (Bedrock)       ${C_YELLOW}17)${C_RESET} Enshrouded"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 5)${C_RESET} Minecraft (Purpur)        ${C_YELLOW}18)${C_RESET} Terraria (tShock)"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 6)${C_RESET} Minecraft (Spigot)        ${C_YELLOW}19)${C_RESET} 7 Days to Die"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 7)${C_RESET} CS2 / CSGO                ${C_YELLOW}20)${C_RESET} Unturned"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 8)${C_RESET} Garry's Mod               ${C_YELLOW}21)${C_RESET} Barotrauma"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 9)${C_RESET} Rust                      ${C_YELLOW}22)${C_RESET} SCP: Secret Lab"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}10)${C_RESET} ARK: Survival Evolved     ${C_YELLOW}23)${C_RESET} Project Zomboid"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}11)${C_RESET} ARK: Survival Ascended    ${C_YELLOW}24)${C_RESET} Valheim"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}12)${C_RESET} DayZ                      ${C_YELLOW}25)${C_RESET} The Forest"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}13)${C_RESET} Conan Exiles               ${C_YELLOW}26)${C_RESET} Custom SteamCMD App"
    echo ""
    prompt_choice "Enter number" game_pick
    
    AIO_CATEGORY="Game Server"
    
    case $game_pick in
        1)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Minecraft Paper"
            install_java 21
            print_info "Downloading Paper..."
            local mc_ver
            prompt_default "Minecraft version" "1.21.4" mc_ver
            local build=$(curl -fsSL "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper/versions/${mc_ver}/builds" | jq '.builds[-1].build')
            curl -fsSL "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper/versions/${mc_ver}/builds/${build}/downloads/paper-${mc_ver}-${build}.jar" -o /home/container/server.jar
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="java -Xms128M -Xmx\${SERVER_MEMORY}M -jar server.jar nogui"
            AIO_INSTALL_CMD="echo eula=true > eula.txt"
            ;;
        2)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Minecraft Forge"
            install_java 17
            print_info "Downloading Forge installer..."
            local forge_ver
            prompt_default "Forge version (e.g. 1.20.1-47.2.0)" "1.20.1-47.2.0" forge_ver
            curl -fsSL "https://maven.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/${forge_ver}/forge-${forge_ver}-installer.jar" -o /home/container/forge-installer.jar
            cd /home/container && java -jar forge-installer.jar --installServer
            rm -f forge-installer.jar
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="java -Xms128M -Xmx\${SERVER_MEMORY}M @libraries/net/minecraftforge/forge/${forge_ver}/unix_args.txt nogui"
            AIO_INSTALL_CMD="echo eula=true > eula.txt"
            ;;
        3)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Minecraft Fabric"
            install_java 21
            print_info "Downloading Fabric..."
            curl -fsSL "https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/installer" -o /tmp/fab.json
            local fab_url=$(jq -r '.[0].url' /tmp/fab.json)
            curl -fsSL "$fab_url" -o /home/container/fabric-installer.jar
            cd /home/container
            local mc_ver
            prompt_default "Minecraft version" "1.21.4" mc_ver
            java -jar fabric-installer.jar server -mcversion "$mc_ver" -downloadMinecraft
            rm -f fabric-installer.jar
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="java -Xms128M -Xmx\${SERVER_MEMORY}M -jar fabric-server-launch.jar nogui"
            AIO_INSTALL_CMD="echo eula=true > eula.txt"
            ;;
        4)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Minecraft Bedrock"
            print_info "Downloading Bedrock Dedicated Server..."
            local bds_url=$(curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nicholasgasior/bds-downloads/main/versions.json" | jq -r '.linux | to_entries | sort_by(.key) | last | .value')
            curl -fsSL "$bds_url" -o /tmp/bedrock.zip
            cd /home/container && unzip -o /tmp/bedrock.zip
            chmod +x bedrock_server
            rm -f /tmp/bedrock.zip
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="LD_LIBRARY_PATH=. ./bedrock_server"
            ;;
        5)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Minecraft Purpur"
            install_java 21
            local mc_ver
            prompt_default "Minecraft version" "1.21.4" mc_ver
            curl -fsSL "https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur/${mc_ver}/latest/download" -o /home/container/server.jar
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="java -Xms128M -Xmx\${SERVER_MEMORY}M -jar server.jar nogui"
            AIO_INSTALL_CMD="echo eula=true > eula.txt"
            ;;
        6)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Minecraft Spigot"
            install_java 17
            curl -fsSL "https://hub.spigotmc.org/jenkins/job/BuildTools/lastSuccessfulBuild/artifact/target/BuildTools.jar" -o /home/container/BuildTools.jar
            cd /home/container && java -jar BuildTools.jar --rev latest
            mv spigot-*.jar server.jar
            rm -f BuildTools.jar
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="java -Xms128M -Xmx\${SERVER_MEMORY}M -jar server.jar nogui"
            AIO_INSTALL_CMD="echo eula=true > eula.txt"
            ;;
        7)  AIO_SOFTWARE="CS2"; setup_game_steamcmd 730 "Counter-Strike 2"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./game/bin/linuxsteamrt64/cs2 -dedicated -port \${SERVER_PORT} +game_type 0 +game_mode 0 +map de_dust2"
            ;;
        8)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Garry's Mod"; setup_game_steamcmd 4020 "Garry's Mod"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./srcds_run -game garrysmod -port \${SERVER_PORT} +maxplayers 16 +map gm_flatgrass"
            ;;
        9)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Rust"; setup_game_steamcmd 258550 "Rust Dedicated Server"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./RustDedicated -batchmode +server.port \${SERVER_PORT} +server.level Procedural Map +server.maxplayers 50"
            ;;
        10) AIO_SOFTWARE="ARK SE"; setup_game_steamcmd 376030 "ARK: Survival Evolved Server"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server/ShooterGame/Binaries/Linux && ./ShooterGameServer TheIsland?listen -server -log"
            ;;
        11) AIO_SOFTWARE="ARK SA"; setup_game_steamcmd 2430930 "ARK: Survival Ascended Server"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./ShooterGame/Binaries/Win64/ArkAscendedServer.exe TheIsland_WP?listen -server -log"
            ;;
        12) AIO_SOFTWARE="DayZ"; setup_game_steamcmd 223350 "DayZ Server"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./DayZServer -config=serverDZ.cfg -port=\${SERVER_PORT}"
            ;;
        13) AIO_SOFTWARE="Conan Exiles"; setup_game_steamcmd 443030 "Conan Exiles Server"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./ConanSandboxServer -log"
            ;;
        14) AIO_SOFTWARE="Palworld"; setup_game_steamcmd 2394010 "Palworld Server"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./PalServer.sh -port=\${SERVER_PORT}"
            ;;
        15) AIO_SOFTWARE="Satisfactory"; setup_game_steamcmd 1690800 "Satisfactory Server"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./FactoryServer.sh -Port=\${SERVER_PORT}"
            ;;
        16) AIO_SOFTWARE="V Rising"; setup_game_steamcmd 1829350 "V Rising Server"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./VRisingServer -persistentDataPath ./save-data -logFile ./logs/VRisingServer.log"
            ;;
        17) AIO_SOFTWARE="Enshrouded"; setup_game_steamcmd 2278520 "Enshrouded Server"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./enshrouded_server"
            ;;
        18) AIO_SOFTWARE="Terraria"; 
            print_info "Downloading tShock..."
            local tshock_url=$(curl -fsSL "https://api.github.com/repos/Pryaxis/TShock/releases/latest" | jq -r '.assets[0].browser_download_url')
            mkdir -p /home/container/server
            curl -fsSL "$tshock_url" -o /tmp/tshock.zip
            cd /home/container/server && unzip -o /tmp/tshock.zip && rm /tmp/tshock.zip
            chmod +x TShock.Server
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./TShock.Server -port \${SERVER_PORT} -maxplayers 8 -world /home/container/server/worlds/world.wld -autocreate 3"
            ;;
        19) AIO_SOFTWARE="7 Days to Die"; setup_game_steamcmd 294420 "7 Days to Die Server"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./7DaysToDieServer.x86_64 -logfile /dev/stdout -configfile=serverconfig.xml"
            ;;
        20) AIO_SOFTWARE="Unturned"; setup_game_steamcmd 1110390 "Unturned Server"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./Unturned -batchmode -nographics +InternetServer/\${SERVER_PORT}"
            ;;
        21) AIO_SOFTWARE="Barotrauma"; setup_game_steamcmd 1026340 "Barotrauma Server"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./DedicatedServer"
            ;;
        22) AIO_SOFTWARE="SCP: Secret Lab"; setup_game_steamcmd 996560 "SCP:SL Server"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./LocalAdmin \${SERVER_PORT}"
            ;;
        23) AIO_SOFTWARE="Project Zomboid"; setup_game_steamcmd 380870 "Project Zomboid Server"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./start-server.sh"
            ;;
        24) AIO_SOFTWARE="Valheim"; setup_game_steamcmd 896660 "Valheim Server"
            local sv_name
            prompt_default "Server name" "Forge Valheim" sv_name
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ./valheim_server.x86_64 -name \"${sv_name}\" -port \${SERVER_PORT} -world Dedicated -password secret -public 1"
            ;;
        25) AIO_SOFTWARE="The Forest"; setup_game_steamcmd 556450 "The Forest Server"
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && wine64 TheForestDedicatedServer.exe -serverip 0.0.0.0 -serversteamport \${SERVER_PORT}"
            ;;
        26) AIO_SOFTWARE="Custom SteamCMD"
            local app_id
            prompt_choice "Enter Steam App ID" app_id
            local custom_name
            prompt_default "Game name" "Custom Game" custom_name
            setup_game_steamcmd "$app_id" "$custom_name"
            local custom_cmd
            prompt_choice "Enter startup command (relative to server/)" custom_cmd
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd server && ${custom_cmd}"
            ;;
        *) print_error "Invalid choice"; return 1 ;;
    esac
    AIO_TYPE="game_server"
}

wizard_bot_app() {
    print_step "Bot / Application Setup"
    echo ""
    echo -e "  ${C_WHITE}${C_BOLD}What are you building?${C_RESET}"
    echo ""
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 1)${C_RESET} Node.js Bot/App (Discord.js, etc.)"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 2)${C_RESET} Python Bot/App (discord.py, etc.)"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 3)${C_RESET} Java Application"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 4)${C_RESET} Bun Application"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 5)${C_RESET} Go Application"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 6)${C_RESET} Rust Application"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 7)${C_RESET} C# / .NET Application"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 8)${C_RESET} Red Discord Bot (Redbot)"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW} 9)${C_RESET} Custom (specify runtime)"
    echo ""
    prompt_choice "Enter number" bot_pick
    
    AIO_CATEGORY="Bot / Application"
    AIO_TYPE="bot_app"
    
    case $bot_pick in
        1)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Node.js"
            local node_ver
            prompt_default "Node.js version" "20" node_ver
            install_nvm_node "$node_ver"
            local entry
            prompt_default "Entry file" "index.js" entry
            if confirm_yn "Clone from Git repo?"; then
                local git_url
                prompt_choice "Git URL" git_url
                git clone "$git_url" /home/container/app 2>/dev/null || git pull
                AIO_STARTUP_CMD="source /home/container/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd app && npm install && node ${entry}"
            else
                mkdir -p /home/container/app
                AIO_STARTUP_CMD="source /home/container/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd app && npm install 2>/dev/null; node ${entry}"
            fi
            AIO_INSTALL_CMD="cd app && npm init -y 2>/dev/null"
            ;;
        2)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Python"
            install_python
            local entry
            prompt_default "Main Python file" "main.py" entry
            if confirm_yn "Clone from Git repo?"; then
                local git_url
                prompt_choice "Git URL" git_url
                git clone "$git_url" /home/container/app 2>/dev/null || git pull
                AIO_STARTUP_CMD="source /home/container/.venv/bin/activate && cd app && pip install -r requirements.txt 2>/dev/null; python3 ${entry}"
            else
                mkdir -p /home/container/app
                AIO_STARTUP_CMD="source /home/container/.venv/bin/activate && cd app && pip install -r requirements.txt 2>/dev/null; python3 ${entry}"
            fi
            ;;
        3)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Java"
            local jver
            prompt_default "Java version" "17" jver
            install_java "$jver"
            local jar
            prompt_default "JAR file" "app.jar" jar
            mkdir -p /home/container/app
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="cd app && java -jar ${jar}"
            ;;
        4)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Bun"
            print_info "Installing Bun..."
            curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
            export PATH="/home/container/.bun/bin:$PATH"
            local entry
            prompt_default "Entry file" "index.ts" entry
            mkdir -p /home/container/app
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="export PATH=/home/container/.bun/bin:\$PATH && cd app && bun install 2>/dev/null; bun run ${entry}"
            ;;
        5)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Go"
            install_go
            local entry
            prompt_default "Main file" "main.go" entry
            mkdir -p /home/container/app
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="export PATH=/home/container/.go/bin:\$PATH && cd app && go run ${entry}"
            ;;
        6)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Rust"
            install_rust
            mkdir -p /home/container/app
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="source /home/container/.cargo/env && cd app && cargo run --release"
            ;;
        7)  AIO_SOFTWARE="C# .NET"
            print_info "Installing .NET SDK..."
            curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh | bash -s -- --channel LTS --install-dir /home/container/.dotnet
            export PATH="/home/container/.dotnet:$PATH"
            mkdir -p /home/container/app
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="export PATH=/home/container/.dotnet:\$PATH && cd app && dotnet run"
            ;;
        8)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Redbot"
            install_python
            source /home/container/.venv/bin/activate
            pip install Red-DiscordBot
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="source /home/container/.venv/bin/activate && redbot mybot --no-prompt"
            AIO_INSTALL_CMD="source /home/container/.venv/bin/activate && redbot-setup"
            ;;
        9)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Custom Runtime"
            local cmd
            prompt_choice "Full startup command" cmd
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="$cmd"
            ;;
        *) print_error "Invalid choice"; return 1 ;;
    esac
}

wizard_web() {
    print_step "Website / Web App Setup"
    echo ""
    echo -e "  ${C_WHITE}${C_BOLD}What kind of web project?${C_RESET}"
    echo ""
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}1)${C_RESET} Static Site (Nginx)"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}2)${C_RESET} Node.js Web App (Express, Next.js, etc.)"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}3)${C_RESET} Python Web App (Flask, Django, FastAPI)"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}4)${C_RESET} PHP Site (Apache + PHP)"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}5)${C_RESET} Code Server (VS Code in browser)"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}6)${C_RESET} Gitea (Self-hosted Git)"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}7)${C_RESET} Uptime Kuma (Monitoring)"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}8)${C_RESET} Haste / Pastebin"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}9)${C_RESET} ShareX Upload Server"
    echo ""
    prompt_choice "Enter number" web_pick
    
    AIO_CATEGORY="Website / Web App"
    AIO_TYPE="web"
    
    case $web_pick in
        1)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Nginx Static"
            install_nginx
            mkdir -p /home/container/www
            echo '<html><body><h1>Forge AIO - Site Live!</h1><p>Upload your files to /www</p></body></html>' > /home/container/www/index.html
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="nginx -g 'daemon off;' -c /home/container/.forge-aio/nginx.conf"
            mkdir -p /home/container/.forge-aio
            cat > /home/container/.forge-aio/nginx.conf << 'NGINX'
events { worker_connections 128; }
http {
    server {
        listen ${SERVER_PORT};
        root /home/container/www;
        index index.html;
        location / { try_files $uri $uri/ =404; }
    }
}
NGINX
            ;;
        2)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Node.js Web App"
            install_nvm_node 20
            mkdir -p /home/container/app
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="source /home/container/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd app && npm install && npm start"
            ;;
        3)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Python Web App"
            install_python
            local framework
            prompt_default "Framework (flask/django/fastapi)" "flask" framework
            mkdir -p /home/container/app
            source /home/container/.venv/bin/activate
            pip install "$framework" gunicorn uvicorn
            if [ "$framework" = "fastapi" ]; then
                AIO_STARTUP_CMD="source /home/container/.venv/bin/activate && cd app && uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port \${SERVER_PORT}"
            elif [ "$framework" = "django" ]; then
                AIO_STARTUP_CMD="source /home/container/.venv/bin/activate && cd app && python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:\${SERVER_PORT}"
            else
                AIO_STARTUP_CMD="source /home/container/.venv/bin/activate && cd app && python main.py"
            fi
            ;;
        4)  AIO_SOFTWARE="PHP"
            install_php
            mkdir -p /home/container/www
            echo '<?php phpinfo(); ?>' > /home/container/www/index.php
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="php -S 0.0.0.0:\${SERVER_PORT} -t /home/container/www"
            ;;
        5)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Code Server"
            print_info "Installing Code Server..."
            curl -fsSL https://code-server.dev/install.sh | sh -s -- --prefix=/home/container/.code-server
            local cs_pass
            prompt_default "Password" "forgeaio" cs_pass
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="/home/container/.code-server/bin/code-server --bind-addr 0.0.0.0:\${SERVER_PORT} --auth password --user-data-dir /home/container/.code-data /home/container"
            export PASSWORD="$cs_pass"
            ;;
        6)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Gitea"
            print_info "Installing Gitea..."
            local gitea_url=$(curl -fsSL "https://api.github.com/repos/go-gitea/gitea/releases/latest" | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name | test("linux-amd64$")) | .browser_download_url')
            curl -fsSL "$gitea_url" -o /home/container/gitea && chmod +x /home/container/gitea
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="/home/container/gitea web --port \${SERVER_PORT}"
            ;;
        7)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Uptime Kuma"
            install_nvm_node 20
            print_info "Installing Uptime Kuma..."
            git clone https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma.git /home/container/uptime-kuma 2>/dev/null
            cd /home/container/uptime-kuma && npm ci --production
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="source /home/container/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /home/container/uptime-kuma && node server/server.js --port=\${SERVER_PORT}"
            ;;
        8)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Haste"
            install_nvm_node 20
            git clone https://github.com/toptal/haste-server.git /home/container/haste 2>/dev/null
            cd /home/container/haste && npm install
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="source /home/container/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /home/container/haste && npm start"
            ;;
        9)  AIO_SOFTWARE="ShareX Upload"
            install_nvm_node 20
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="source /home/container/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd app && npm start"
            ;;
        *) print_error "Invalid choice"; return 1 ;;
    esac
}

wizard_database() {
    print_step "Database Setup"
    echo ""
    echo -e "  ${C_WHITE}${C_BOLD}Pick your database:${C_RESET}"
    echo ""
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}1)${C_RESET} MongoDB"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}2)${C_RESET} Redis"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}3)${C_RESET} MariaDB / MySQL"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}4)${C_RESET} PostgreSQL"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}5)${C_RESET} InfluxDB"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}6)${C_RESET} Grafana (Dashboard)"
    echo ""
    prompt_choice "Enter number" db_pick
    
    AIO_CATEGORY="Database"
    AIO_TYPE="database"
    
    case $db_pick in
        1)  AIO_SOFTWARE="MongoDB"
            install_mongodb
            mkdir -p /home/container/.mongodb/data
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="/home/container/.mongodb/bin/mongod --dbpath /home/container/.mongodb/data --port \${SERVER_PORT} --bind_ip 0.0.0.0"
            ;;
        2)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Redis"
            install_redis
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="/home/container/.redis/bin/redis-server --port \${SERVER_PORT} --bind 0.0.0.0 --dir /home/container"
            ;;
        3)  AIO_SOFTWARE="MariaDB"
            install_mariadb
            mkdir -p /home/container/.mariadb/data
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="mysqld --datadir=/home/container/.mariadb/data --port=\${SERVER_PORT} --socket=/tmp/mysql.sock --skip-grant-tables"
            AIO_INSTALL_CMD="mysql_install_db --datadir=/home/container/.mariadb/data"
            ;;
        4)  AIO_SOFTWARE="PostgreSQL"
            install_postgres
            mkdir -p /home/container/.pgdata
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="pg_ctlcluster 16 main start && tail -f /var/log/postgresql/*.log"
            ;;
        5)  AIO_SOFTWARE="InfluxDB"
            print_info "Installing InfluxDB..."
            curl -fsSL https://dl.influxdata.com/influxdb/releases/influxdb2-2.7.5_linux_amd64.tar.gz -o /tmp/influx.tar.gz
            mkdir -p /home/container/.influxdb
            tar xzf /tmp/influx.tar.gz -C /home/container/.influxdb --strip-components=1 && rm /tmp/influx.tar.gz
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="/home/container/.influxdb/influxd --http-bind-address :${SERVER_PORT} --bolt-path /home/container/.influxdb/influxd.bolt --engine-path /home/container/.influxdb/engine"
            ;;
        6)  AIO_SOFTWARE="Grafana"
            print_info "Installing Grafana..."
            curl -fsSL https://dl.grafana.com/oss/release/grafana-11.0.0.linux-amd64.tar.gz -o /tmp/grafana.tar.gz
            mkdir -p /home/container/.grafana
            tar xzf /tmp/grafana.tar.gz -C /home/container/.grafana --strip-components=1 && rm /tmp/grafana.tar.gz
            AIO_STARTUP_CMD="/home/container/.grafana/bin/grafana-server --homepath /home/container/.grafana --config /home/container/.grafana/conf/defaults.ini"
            ;;
        *) print_error "Invalid choice"; return 1 ;;
    esac
}

wizard_custom() {
    print_step "Custom Setup"
    echo ""
    echo -e "  ${C_WHITE}${C_BOLD}Full control mode.${C_RESET}"
    echo -e "  ${C_DIM}  You specify exactly what to install and run.${C_RESET}"
    echo ""
    
    AIO_CATEGORY="Custom"
    AIO_TYPE="custom"
    AIO_SOFTWARE="Custom"
    
    if confirm_yn "Run install commands first?"; then
        local install_cmd
        prompt_choice "Install command (e.g. apt install -y nginx)" install_cmd
        print_info "Running: ${install_cmd}"
        eval "$install_cmd"
        AIO_INSTALL_CMD="$install_cmd"
    fi
    
    local start_cmd
    prompt_choice "Startup command" start_cmd
    AIO_STARTUP_CMD="$start_cmd"
}

run_wizard() {
    print_banner
    echo -e "  ${C_WHITE}Welcome! Let's set up your server.${C_RESET}"
    echo -e "  ${C_DIM}You can reconfigure anytime by typing: forgeaio setup${C_RESET}"
    print_line
    echo ""
    echo -e "  ${C_WHITE}${C_BOLD}What do you want to run?${C_RESET}"
    echo ""
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}1)${C_RESET} 🎮  Game Server       ${C_DIM}(Minecraft, CS2, Rust, Palworld, 26+ games)${C_RESET}"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}2)${C_RESET} 🤖  Bot / Application  ${C_DIM}(Node.js, Python, Java, Go, Rust, C#)${C_RESET}"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}3)${C_RESET} 🌐  Website / Web App  ${C_DIM}(Nginx, Express, Django, PHP, Code Server)${C_RESET}"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}4)${C_RESET} 🗄️  Database           ${C_DIM}(MongoDB, Redis, MariaDB, PostgreSQL)${C_RESET}"
    echo -e "  ${C_YELLOW}5)${C_RESET} ⚙️  Custom             ${C_DIM}(Full control — specify your own commands)${C_RESET}"
    echo ""
    prompt_choice "Enter number (1-5)" main_pick
    
    case $main_pick in
        1) wizard_game_server ;;
        2) wizard_bot_app ;;
        3) wizard_web ;;
        4) wizard_database ;;
        5) wizard_custom ;;
        *) print_error "Invalid choice. Please restart and pick 1-5."; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    
    echo ""
    print_line
    print_success "Setup complete!"
    echo -e "  ${C_DIM}Software:${C_RESET} ${C_BOLD}${AIO_SOFTWARE}${C_RESET}"
    echo -e "  ${C_DIM}Category:${C_RESET} ${AIO_CATEGORY}"
    echo -e "  ${C_DIM}Startup: ${C_RESET} ${C_DIM}${AIO_STARTUP_CMD}${C_RESET}"
    print_line
    echo ""
    
    save_config
    
    # Run any one-time install commands
    if [ -n "$AIO_INSTALL_CMD" ]; then
        print_info "Running post-install setup..."
        cd /home/container
        eval "$AIO_INSTALL_CMD" 2>/dev/null
    fi
}

start_service() {
    load_config
    echo ""
    print_banner
    echo -e "  ${C_GREEN}${C_BOLD}Starting: ${AIO_SOFTWARE}${C_RESET}  ${C_DIM}(${AIO_CATEGORY})${C_RESET}"
    echo -e "  ${C_DIM}Type 'forgeaio setup' in console to reconfigure${C_RESET}"
    print_line
    echo ""
    
    # Set up PATH for various runtimes
    [ -d "/home/container/.nvm" ] && source /home/container/.nvm/nvm.sh 2>/dev/null
    [ -d "/home/container/.venv" ] && source /home/container/.venv/bin/activate 2>/dev/null
    [ -d "/home/container/.cargo" ] && source /home/container/.cargo/env 2>/dev/null
    [ -d "/home/container/.go/bin" ] && export PATH="/home/container/.go/bin:$PATH"
    [ -d "/home/container/.dotnet" ] && export PATH="/home/container/.dotnet:$PATH"
    [ -d "/home/container/.bun/bin" ] && export PATH="/home/container/.bun/bin:$PATH"
    [ -d "/home/container/.java/bin" ] && export PATH="/home/container/.java/bin:$PATH"
    [ -d "/home/container/.redis/bin" ] && export PATH="/home/container/.redis/bin:$PATH"
    [ -d "/home/container/.mongodb/bin" ] && export PATH="/home/container/.mongodb/bin:$PATH"
    [ -d "/home/container/.steamcmd" ] && export PATH="/home/container/.steamcmd:$PATH"
    
    cd /home/container
    echo -e "${LOG_PREFIX} ${C_GREEN}Service is running${C_RESET}"
    
    # Replace shell with the actual service
    exec bash -c "${AIO_STARTUP_CMD}"
}

## ─── Main ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Install jq if not present
if ! command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
    apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq jq 2>/dev/null || {
        curl -fsSL https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/download/jq-1.7.1/jq-linux-amd64 -o /usr/local/bin/jq && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/jq
    }
fi

# Create forgeaio command alias
if [ ! -f /usr/local/bin/forgeaio ]; then
    cat > /usr/local/bin/forgeaio << 'ALIAS'
#!/bin/bash
if [ "$1" = "setup" ] || [ "$1" = "wizard" ] || [ "$1" = "reconfigure" ]; then
    rm -f /home/container/.forge-aio/config.json
    echo "[Forge AIO] Reconfiguring... Restart the server to run setup wizard."
elif [ "$1" = "info" ] || [ "$1" = "status" ]; then
    if [ -f /home/container/.forge-aio/config.json ]; then
        echo "=== Forge AIO Configuration ==="
        cat /home/container/.forge-aio/config.json | jq .
    else
        echo "Not configured yet. Start the server to run the setup wizard."
    fi
else
    echo "Usage: forgeaio <setup|info>"
    echo "  setup  - Reconfigure (runs wizard on next start)"
    echo "  info   - Show current configuration"
fi
ALIAS
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/forgeaio
fi

# Check if first argument is "setup" (typed in console)
if [[ "${1}" == "setup" ]] || [[ "${1}" == "wizard" ]]; then
    rm -f "$CONFIG_FILE"
fi

# Main flow
if [ -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ] && jq -e '.configured' "$CONFIG_FILE" &>/dev/null; then
    start_service
else
    run_wizard
    echo ""
    print_info "Starting your ${AIO_SOFTWARE} server now..."
    echo ""
    sleep 2
    start_service
fi
ENTRYPOINT_EOF

chmod +x /mnt/server/.forge-aio/entrypoint.sh

## ─── Create default directory structure ──────────────────────────────────────
mkdir -p /mnt/server/app
mkdir -p /mnt/server/server
mkdir -p /mnt/server/www

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Forge AIO installed successfully!"
echo "Start the server to run the setup wizard."
echo "-----------------------------------------"
